P.name: Ionian Fervor
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Irelia''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ionian Fervor'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by her {{tip|abilities}}, or if she hits at least one non-champion, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} and ability hits against enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monster|monsters}}, and {{tip|structures}}, and stacking up to 4 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Ionian Fervor:}} For each stack, '''Irelia''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 25|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*4 to 25*4|key=%}}|attack speed}}. At maximum stacks, '''Irelia's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|{{pplevel|10 to 61}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pplevel|10*0.5 to 61*0.5}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}against structures.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Unsteady:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit by ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}}'' or ''{{ais|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}'' initial barrage are {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''Unsteady'' for 5 seconds. The mark can be consumed by ''{{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}''.

Q.name: Bladesurge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' {{tip|dashes}} 100 units through the target enemy's location, and upon collision or dash completion, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and {{tip|heal|heals}} herself. ''Bladesurge'' deals {{as|{{pplevel|50 to 237}} '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description2: ''Bladesurge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.2}} seconds upon collision of targets {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''{{cci|Bladesurge 2.png|Irelia/LoL#Ionian Fervor|Unsteady}}'', and is {{tt|reset|The check's cadence is 0.0625 seconds, or a bit less than 2 game ticks}} if the target dies to or during ''Bladesurge's'' dash.
Q.description3: ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Defiant Dance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' assumes a defensive stance with her blades to {{tip|channel|charge}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which she reduces incoming {{as|physical damage}} by {{pp|40 to 70|key=%}} {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}} and incoming {{as|magic damage}} by {{pp|40*0.5 to 70*0.5|key=%}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.5}}% per 100 AP)}}. Additionally, ''Defiant Dance's'' damage increases over the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds of the channel.
W.description2: ''Defiant Dance'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Defiant Dance's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' swipes her blades in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies around her and within a line, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 0.75|formula=20% per 0.075 seconds. ''This is capped at 0.75 seconds.''}}. She also retains the damage reduction for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
W.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 50*3}} {{as|(+ 120% AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
W.description4: ''Defiant Dance's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. {{ais|Ionian Fervor|Irelia}} duration is paused during the charge; if {{ai|Ionian Fervor|Irelia}} has less than 1 second remaining when the charge starts, it is set to 1 second when the charge ends.''

E.name: Flawless Duet
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' sends a blade to the target location for {{fd|3.5}} seconds. ''Flawless Duet'' can be recast after {{fd|0.15}} seconds while the blade is active, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if ''Flawless Duet'' was recast automatically.
E.description3: Once both blades have been placed, they fly toward each other regardless of distance and converge over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, afterwards dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within a line between them and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
E.description4: ''Flawless Duet's recast can be used during {{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}} and the cast time of {{ai|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}, but is not used automatically while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities. Each of the blades' travel times are {{rutngt|0.25}}.''

R.name: Vanguard's Edge
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' launches a barrage of blades in the target direction, expanding outward upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second.
R.description2: After expanding, the blades drop on the ground, knocking all enemy units away from them, though not rendering them {{tip|airborne}}, and forming a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for {{fd|2.5}} seconds that grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description3: ''The perimeter will point at the same angle '''Irelia''' cast it from, but based on the target's center.''
